params.caption: 🎮 Beyond Skyrim: Bruma 2.0 is out — and it's coming to PlayStation The fan-made mod that recreates Cyrodiil's northern city of Bruma inside Skyrim has received a huge 2.0 update, almost 10 years after it first launched. Alongside the update, the mod is also getting a PlayStation port, bringing it to console players for the first time. 🕒 Nov 11, 2026 · 18:58 (GMT+3) 📰 Source: VGC 🔥 React if you're jumping back into Skyrim · 💬 Which mod should hit consoles next? #Skyrim #BeyondSkyrim #GamingNews
